title: Exact Controllability for Stochastic First-Order Multi-Dimensional Hyperbolic Systems
summary: This paper investigates the exact controllability problem for multi-dimensional stochastic first-order symmetric hyperbolic systems with control inputs acting in two distinct ways: an internal control applied to the diffusion term and a boundary control applied to the drift term. By means of a classical duality argument, the controllability problem is reduced to an observability estimate for the corresponding backward stochastic system. The main technical contribution is the establishment of a new global Carleman estimate for such backward systems, combined with a weighted energy identity.…
